The sharding function does not guarantee that `model.embed_tokens.weight` is stored alone: at roughly 412 MB, it is below the 512 MiB limit, so subsequent tensors may be packed into the same shard. This violates the explicit sharding clause requiring both `model.embed_tokens.weight` and `lm_head.weight` to occupy individual shards.
